x: The notes fix quarterly buffer norms as on 1 April, 1 July, 1 October and 1 January (set by the CCEA); option A lists exactly these four dates in calendar order.

The Act (passed 2005) came into force as NREGA in 2006 and was renamed MGNREGA in 2009, so A is right. B reverses the dates, the guarantee is 100 days (not 125) per household, and social audit is part of the scheme.

Amaravati is the capital of Andhra Pradesh (the AP Capital Region), where a UN-Habitat Centre of Excellence is to be set up. The first municipal bond was issued by Bangalore (1997), and Nigama Sabha was the Satavahana city-administration body.
